pt.titulo: Colorado community fights plan to use drones to spray weed killer
pt.resumo_biocultura: Officials in Boulder County, Colorado, say they have a safe plan to wipe out invasive weeds, but some locals are concerned Soon, weed-killing chemicals will start falling from the sky over the Red Hill area of Boulder county, Colorado. The wildland is known for its biodiversity , home to hundreds of important species and a concentration of rare environmental resources. It is a key habitat for beloved herds of elk and bighorn sheep, with farms and ranchland lying at its base

pt.titulo: Challenge or opportunity: climate policy uncertainty and green merger and acquisition
pt.resumo_biocultura: The Real Options Theory and the Growth Options Theory offer contrasting views on investment under uncertainty, with the former seeing it as a challenge and the latter as an opportunity. Using data from Chinese listed firms from 2000 to 2023, this paper documents a positive relationship between climate policy uncertainty (CPU) and firms’ green mergers and acquisitions (M&As). Specifically, a one-standard-deviation increase in CPU is associated with an approximately 1.2 percent
